definitions.explanation: The fourth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly June 22 to July 22. Also the constellation Cancer. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蟹座|かにざ}だ。
{蟹座|かにざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: Cancer people are said to value their family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蟹座|かにざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}いがけない⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧らしい。
examples.english: According to the horoscope, Cancer will have an unexpected encounter this week.

notes:
The zodiac sign Cancer, for people born from late June to late July.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蟹座|かにざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Cancer
- {蟹座|かにざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Cancer
- {蟹座|かにざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Cancer horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
